svg.title: Keep the Run—or verify a new one
svg.desc: Same-Run handling checks original identity, receipts and recovery eligibility. Ordinary Root cold re-entry settles; only an accepted Human or Child wake may continue within bounds. Continue verifies parent, original request, grants and source eligibility before creating a new Run; ineligible requests are refused. Unknown effects are not treated as unexecuted.

g.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Keep the Run—or verify a new one
Same Run: the original recovery contract
Check identity, receipts and wake eligibility
Ordinary Root cold re-entry: settle, retain results
A checkpoint alone cannot restart the model
Keep lease, format and resource constraints
First verify parent, request, grants and sources
Ineligible → refuse; do not create an execution
Eligible → durably admit a new linked Run
Handle the new request, not the old effects
Current admission and resource limits still apply
Reopening history is neither execution action.
Neither path treats unknown effects as absent.
